body:
## Context

Falls out of the Ratel evaluation recorded in
`docs/ai/decisions/2026-07-23-semantic-scope-injection.md` (now `superseded`).

Verdict there: **do not adopt [`ratel-ai/ratel`](https://github.com/ratel-ai/ratel)** — it re-implements layers Rhythm already ships, and its model-discretionary `search_capabilities` would replace a fail-closed authz gate. But two of its ideas are worth taking without the dependency, and both are cheaper than the parked MiniLM/ONNX embedder design.

Neither item adds a dependency. Both are independent — split into two PRs.

---

## Item 1 — BM25 in place of Jaccard in `skill_retrieval.ts` (measure first)

`apps/api_server/src/services/skill_retrieval.ts` ranks DB skills against the incoming message with **Jaccard token overlap** (`THRESHOLD = 0.3`, `DEFAULT_TOP_N = 5`) and emits a transient prompt preface.

Jaccard's known failure mode is exactly Rhythm's shape: it has **no IDF weighting** (a match on "the" counts like a match on "propresenter") and **no document-length normalization** (`union = |a| + |b| - inter`, so a long, well-written skill description is *penalized* for being thorough). BM25 fixes both and still needs no embeddings, no vector store, no model file.

**Do not swap on principle — measure first.** Gate the work on evidence:

1. Instrument or replay real session prompts against the current scorer; capture cases where a relevant skill scored below `THRESHOLD` (paraphrase misses) and cases where an irrelevant one made top-5.
2. Only if misses are real, swap the scorer behind the existing `THRESHOLD` / `DEFAULT_TOP_N` knobs.

Notes:
- `jaccard()` is a pure local function — the swap is contained. `tokenize()` can stay as-is (it deliberately mirrors the Odysseus reference; see the comment at L36-49).
- `THRESHOLD = 0.3` is a Jaccard-scale number. BM25 scores are unbounded, so the threshold must be re-derived (or switched to a top-N-only / relative-to-best cut), not carried over.
- This module is **not** the enforcement boundary (see the SCOPE NOTE at L16-25) — it is a hint preface. Ranking changes cannot widen what a model may load, which keeps the blast radius small.

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Measurement recorded in `docs/ai/runs/` — real prompts, current scorer, count/examples of paraphrase misses. If there are none, **close this item as not-needed** and say so in the run log.
- [ ] If proceeding: BM25 scorer replaces `jaccard()`, thresholding re-derived for the new score scale, existing unit tests updated.
- [ ] Before/after on the same prompt set shows recall improved with no top-5 precision regression.
- [ ] The scorer stays a pure function; no new dependency; no change to the enforcement path.

---

## Item 2 — Widen the deferred dispatcher beyond unscoped-Gemini

`apps/opencode_fork/.../session/mcp_deferred_tools.ts` already implements progressive disclosure: when `mcpAllowlist.deferred` is set, one dispatcher tool is advertised and schemas load on demand.

Today it is reachable through exactly one path — `opencode_client_service.ts::createSession` (~L1040) calls `geminiUnscopedDeferredAllowlist(...)`, which is a **512-function-declaration proto-cap workaround** for `google` (`gemini_tool_cap.ts`, #952) and returns `null` for every other provider. So deferred is:

- never used on scoped profiles, and
- never used on non-Gemini providers,

i.e. it is a crash guard, not a token lever. The 2026-07-23 parking note already named "leaning on the existing deferred dispatcher for fat servers" as a cheap win; it was never done.

**Change:** let a *scoped* profile mark individual fat servers deferred, on any provider — dispatcher-only for those servers, full schemas for the rest.

Notes:
- The enforcement gate does not change. Deferred is a *presentation* mode inside an allowlist the profile already authorizes; it must not widen scope.
- MCP stays **fail-closed** — empty/malformed allowlist remains deny-all.
- `updateSessionAllowlist` / `updateSessionSkillAllowlist` PATCH per turn from `ws_gateway.ts`; deferred state must survive the per-turn PATCH, not just session-create.
- Keep the Gemini path intact — it is solving a different (hard-cap) problem and must keep working.
- Which servers qualify as "fat" should come from `tool_surface_estimator.ts`, not a hardcoded list.

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A scoped profile can mark a server deferred; verified on a non-google provider.
- [ ] `tool_surface_estimator.ts` before/after numbers recorded in `docs/ai/runs/` for at least one fat-server profile.
- [ ] Deferred selection survives the per-turn allowlist PATCH.
- [ ] Deferred cannot expand the authorized server/tool set — a test asserts a deferred dispatcher still refuses a tool outside the allowlist.
- [ ] Unscoped-Gemini behavior (#952) unchanged; existing `gemini_tool_cap` tests still pass.
- [ ] Behavioral verification per `AGENTS.md` — live test through the real engine inside `tools/dev/sandbox.sh`, result recorded in the run log.

---

## Explicitly out of scope
- Adopting Ratel or `ratel-ai/ratel-mcp`.
- The MiniLM/ONNX embedder, `capability_embeddings` table, and four-class `scope_router` from the superseded decision doc. If Item 1 lands and recall is still short, reopen that design — not before.
title: tokens: BM25 skill scorer + widen deferred dispatcher beyond unscoped-Gemini
